name: Question 2
problem:
Find the general solution to the system of differential equations 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t)-3{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=4{x}_{2}(t).\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
We need to find the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}].$

- Since $A$ is upper-triangular, the eigenvalues are 

$$
{\lambda }_{1}=2\,\text{and}\,{\lambda }_{2}=4.
$$

- Let's go through the process of finding the eigenvectors.

- For ${\lambda }_{1}=2,$ we get 

$$
A-{\lambda }_{1}I=[\begin{aligned}0 & -3 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

So, we get an eigenvector 
${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].$

- For ${\lambda }_{2}=4,$ we get 

$$
A-{\lambda }_{2}I=[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

So, we get an eigenvector 
${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$

Now, we write down the general solution to the given linear system of differential equations: 

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & ={c}_{1}{v}_{1}{e}^{{\lambda }_{1}t}+{c}_{2}{v}_{2}{e}^{{\lambda }_{2}t} \\  & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{2t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}]{e}^{4t},\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R\end{aligned}
$$

Question 2
?

Find the general solution to the system of differential equations {x1′(t)=2x1(t)−3x2(t)x2′(t)=4x2(t).

a
x(t)=c1[20]e2t,c1∈R
b
x(t)=c1[24]e2t+c2[−30]e4t,c1,c2∈R
c
x(t)=c1[10]e2t+c2[−32]e4t,c1,c2∈R
d
x(t)=c1[−32]e4t+c2[10]e4t,c1,c2∈R
e
x(t)=c1[31]e4t,c1∈R
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We need to find the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors of the matrix A=[2−304].

  • Since A is upper-triangular, the eigenvalues are λ1=2andλ2=4.

  • Let's go through the process of finding the eigenvectors.

    • For λ1=2, we get A−λ1I=[0−302]∼[0100]. So, we get an eigenvector v1=[10].

    • For λ2=4, we get A−λ2I=[−2−300]. So, we get an eigenvector v2=[−32].

Now, we write down the general solution to the given linear system of differential equations:

x(t)=c1v1eλ1t+c2v2eλ2t=c1[10]e2t+c2[−32]e4t,c1,c2∈R
